description:
Add round-trip, brute-force, and invalid-input coverage that establishes the arbitrary-constellation path as the modem ground truth.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Tests cover valid round-trips for representative arbitrary constellations and labelings.
- [ ] Tests verify the reference soft demapper against brute-force or analytically equivalent expectations.
- [ ] Invalid builder inputs and malformed labelings are covered by failing tests.

## Notes

This task should leave the reference path suitable for cross-checking the Gray-QAM fast path.
title: Add reference-model tests
